Your bookings in your phone’s or computer’s calendar, kept up to date.

Add it with one button to Google Calendar, Outlook or Apple Calendar, or copy the address into Thunderbird or any app that reads iCalendar (.ics). It has your bookings and the ones you joined, and updates by itself when you book, change or cancel.
Anyone with this address sees your bookings. Do not share it.
Google Calendar can take up to a day to show changes.
The current address stops working; you will have to subscribe again.
Under the GDPR you can take a copy of everything %1$s keeps about you, or delete your account.
Your profile, roles, bookings, the bookings you joined and your notices. JSON is for other apps; CSV opens in a spreadsheet.
Deletes your sign-in account and your personal details for good. This cannot be undone.
This cannot be undone. Download your data first if you want to keep a copy.

Past bookings stay in the council’s statistics, with nothing that identifies you.
Your sign-in account, profile, photo, roles and notices are deleted.

Questions about the app, or something not working? Write to us or call us.
At a facility with a free slot? Book it on the spot and check in whichever way the facility takes.
Hold this QR up to the reader at the door: if the slot is free, it is booked and you are in.
We find the facility you are at with your phone’s location; then type the code at the door. It is checked and never stored.
You are not near any facility that takes bookings with its code.
Open the camera and point it at the QR printed on the door: if the slot is free, it is booked and you are in. First we ask for your location, which is checked and never stored.
Hold your phone to the NFC tag on the door: the entrance page opens and, if the slot is free, it is booked and you are in. We will ask for your location, which is checked and never stored.
Ask at the desk or the staff to book the free slot for you: they can do it with your account or just your name. We find the facility you are at by your location to show you who to ask.
You are not near any facility with contact people.
The code changes every minute and works only once, so a screenshot will not work. Do not share it.
If the reader does not pick it up, turn up the screen brightness.
Your QR could not be loaded. Check your connection.
Add your date of birth in your profile to book with your QR.
Hold your phone to the NFC tag on the door: the entrance page opens and you check in. We will ask for your location, which is checked and never stored.
Booked and checked in. Come in!
Hold this QR up to the reader at the entrance.
Type the code shown at the door or the desk. We will ask for your location: it is checked and never stored.
Open the camera and point it at the QR printed on the door. First we ask for your location, which is checked and never stored.
Tell the facility’s staff your name and they will mark you in.
Tell the facility’s staff your name and they will mark you in. You can find them here:

Turn on precise location, or step outside for a moment, and try again.

Your rating is saved. It helps the council and the people who play.
